pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Offline v002 roof-only revision. No native import or rendering has been performed.
Source wall footprint remains 20 x 12 m, eave 6 m, ridge 8 m. Do not bake the existing 25.8 x 20.5 m map instance scale into this mesh.
Original four material slots retained in exact order. New slot 4 M_PazFarm_Barn_RoofCharcoal_v002 is assigned only to roof sheets, ridge, eave and verge flashings.
Roof corrugation relief reduced from 0.045 m to 0.006 m. Corrugation pitch, wall corrugation, doors and trim are unchanged.
Roof BaseColor PNG median target is sRGB 70,62,68; roughness 0.94, metallic 0, Blender Specular IOR Level 0.20, flat normal map. Appearance matching still depends on native exposure.
Exact original pivot, orientation and all three UCX boxes retained. Ground-centred origin; source front -Y, Z up.
All geometry/textures original CC0 artwork. No satellite pixels used for textures.

pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Open-bed default, 0.8m wide x 4m long, 0.25m raised mulch mound; canopy approx 0.20m above bed.
v002: two rows of 16 plants (32 total). Six trifoliate leaves per plant, 576 geometric leaflets. Red seeded fruits and eight small five-petal flowers retained.
Pivot is the ground centre of the Y=0 short end. Tile translations (0,4*n,0). Geometry stays within the 0.8m x 4m footprint.
Dusty charcoal mulch roughness .79, specular .22, wrinkle-normal amplitude 20 percent of original. Solid geometric leaf silhouettes, two-sided foliage; no plant collision.
Editable deterministic parameters in build_strawberries_v002.py and scene PazFarm_parameters; all textures original CC0 procedural artwork.

projected_leaf_coverage.method: Orthographic XY union of material slots 2/3 triangles over .8 x 4 m; no alpha or rendering.

original_projected_leaf_coverage.method: Orthographic XY union of material slots 2/3 triangles over .8 x 4 m; no alpha or rendering.

originals.method: SHA256 against the before-work baseline of original farm staging inputs and delivery. Revision directory excluded.
